questions.expected_answer: Step 1: By chain rule, dL/dw_ij^(l) = (dL/dz_j^(l)) * (dz_j^(l)/dw_ij^(l)). Step 2: Since z_j^(l) = sum(w_jk a_k) + b, dz_j/dw_ij = a_i^(l-1). Step 3: Let error term delta_j^(l) = dL/dz_j^(l). Then dL/dw_ij = delta_j^(l) * a_i^(l-1).
questions.explanation: The chain rule decomposes the loss derivative into the error term delta of the current neuron multiplied by the activation output of the previous layer.
